description: Road construction Engineers are professionals responsible for the overseeing, costing, estimating, planning as well as implementation of construction projects of roads that connect cities, towns, and states. They play a pivotal role in overseeing all aspects of road construction, from the initial planning and design stages to construction and project completion. Their work ensures that roads are built safely, efficiently, and in compliance with the regulations.
